text: Book an IFB funding qualification call for Aimparency
description: Felix contacts IFB Hamburg's Förderlotsen or Innovationsstarter for one qualification call. Ask which path fits the actual legal/company age and founder situation: InnoFounder (pre-start or under one year; up to €45k solo / €75k team) or InnoRampUp (Hamburg technology startup under two years; up to €150k and up to 90% eligible costs). Do not prepare both applications before eligibility is confirmed. Immediate human action: email foerderlotsen@ifbhh.de with a two-paragraph description and request a call. Record eligibility, next deadline/process, required legal structure, and whether paid customer pilots can run alongside funding.

status.comment: Felix must disclose the real legal/founder situation and book the official qualification call.

reflection: Researched current official IFB program pages and prepared a qualification email in meta/founder-actions-ai-transformation.md. InnoFounder and InnoRampUp appear potentially relevant, but eligibility depends on real legal/company facts and must be confirmed with IFB.
